declarative.why: a board action with style move names the column (a groupBy value) a dragged card moves to; the button's flow does the move

notLower.why: a drag-to-column is a gesture the shell owns; what the move DOES stays a flow, so lifecycle guards and access still decide

twice.note: ONE APP ONLY: ride-hailing `drivers-board` (board of Driver by status, two move actions onto SetDriverStatus), added 2026-11-18.

enforced.note: drive_s2.py asserts the board's two moveTo actions arrive from /api/x/me and that the dispatcher moves a driver AVAILABLE and back through the flow (the Driver lifecycle guard allows a Dispatcher); experience-client.test.mjs covers the drag only for style move + moveTo, with a stub DOM. The drag gesture itself has NOT been driven in a real browser.

taught.bundleLine: a board `groupBy` (an enum field) with a button `style:"move"` + `moveTo`
